California Government Code Section 12955 uses the language "shall make reasonable accommodation" and "shall permit a resident or applicant for tenancy to make reasonable modification" — these are stated as affirmative duties. However, case law and regulatory guidance interpret these as subject to the "reasonable" and "undue hardship" standards, making them conditional rather than absolute requirements as the article's phrasing "generally require...to consider" might suggest.
